description: This file contains the implementation of an Android activity 'Bouncer2' with an inner custom View class 'MyView'. The activity sets a layout, and 'MyView' handles rendering a bitmap that bounces vertically upon user interaction, utilizing Android's animation framework.

classes.name: Bouncer2
classes.description: Main activity that initializes the user interface for bouncing animation.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom View class that displays and animates a bitmap, making it bounce vertically when clicked.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Updates the horizontal position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Updates the vertical position of the shape and invalidates the affected area.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap image and sets up click listener to start animation.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size change, positions shape centrally at bottom for width and at top for height.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and configures the ValueAnimator to animate shape's Y position with bounce effect.

methods.name: getValueAnimator
methods.description: Constructs a ValueAnimator that updates the Y position based on animated fraction, with bounce interpolation.
